title: Canonical internal-Hom comparison from a normalized scalar tensor map
statement: For a normalized scalar and tensor-Hom model M [def-sfb-scalar-hom-comparison-data] and a scalar tensor comparison mu for a:R→S, scalarHomCanonicalIso is the explicit closed-Hom isomorphism [lem-sfb-closed-scalar-hom-comparison] for the given scalar adjunction and mu.iso. Its body constructs the representing maps from five Hom equivalences and their inverses; it selects no arbitrary isomorphism.
